title: Igrot Kodesh - Letter No. 227
response_propositions: The letter confirms that establishing a Kehot branch in Shanghai accorded with the Previous Rebbe's wishes, subject to responsible local supervision.
It directs the students to begin printing three hundred copies of each available title and promises title-page copy, while requiring high-quality paper and binding.
Its postscript maps portion, lot and inheritance to service of heart, service of mind and an inherited awareness of G-dliness.
proposition_source_locator: publisher translation, lines 272-289: Shanghai printing instructions and postscript on inheritance and lot

documented_circumstances: Letter No. 227 to Lubavitch yeshivah students who had taken refuge in Shanghai, dated 27 Nissan 5706, with a postscript to R. Chaim Meir Bukiet.
